note: Pointer to the desk's MCP connector. The connector is read-only market data plus store helpers; it never holds keys or funds.

servers.name: plumbline
servers.title: The Spice Melange Trading Desk: DeepBook market data connector
servers.install: claude mcp add --transport http plumbline https://plumbline-mcp.fly.dev/mcp
servers.pricing: Market data: 100 free calls per day per client, then 0.002 USDC per call on Sui (0.01 USDC minimum payment). Store and desk tools are free; templates cost their store price.
